author: scoobydoo
text: What about busted QM's too? They can be highly reactive on return. Things I've notice about em ----1. There is quite often one on the LTF right before a major turn, like a final IT trick. 2. The reaction level (first shoulder) can still be valid well into the future after prices crosses many time....maybe because of point 3 3. There's quite often a quick move away when QM breaks... and normally a fast drop/ rise to return. This creates nice R/S flip at first shoulder level (which can be nice buy/sell level after change in trend.
